_comment: The whole Discord server as data. discord/setup_server.py reads this file and builds it. Safe to re-run: it only creates what is missing. Kept deliberately short - every channel here is one somebody has a reason to open. Add more later, once a conversation in #guild-chat is too big for #guild-chat.

server.name: <Group of workers>
server.description: Ingen guild, bara en grupp. Horde, PvP. Mondays 19:30.

roles.name: Rank 1 (Middle Mgmt)
roles.about: Officers. They have enough stress already.

roles.name: Rank 4 (does not exist)
roles.about: Do not assign this to anyone. Nobody knows what happened to Rank 4.

roles.name: Tank
roles.about: Pingable. The point of these three is finding the missing one on a Monday.

roles.name: Warrior
roles.about: The class roles exist for one reason: coloured names in the member list.

roles.name: Gaming Monday
roles.about: Opt in to the Monday ping. Opt out, nobody takes it personally.

channels.name: onboarding
channels.topic: Start here. Welcome, the rules, and how Mondays work. One post, pinned, read once.

channels.name: water-cooler
channels.topic: Guild chat. Everything goes here: memes, alts, dings, screenshots of your own death, opinions about loot.

channels.name: all-hands
channels.topic: Announcements. GM posts, and the guild homepage's news when the armory changes.

channels.name: monday-standup
channels.topic: Gamingmandag. 19:30, always has been. One post a week, react to say you are coming.

channels.name: offsites
channels.topic: Dungeon runs that are not Monday. Post an instance and a time, collect people, go. Need one more? Ask here.

channels.name: internal-tools
channels.topic: Addons, macros, keybinds, UI screenshots. The channel you search six weeks later.

channels.name: Open Office
channels.topic: The one that matters. Join when you log in and leave it running.

channels.name: Meeting Room 2
channels.topic: For when a group splits in two, or someone needs to take a call.
